text:
BPR-max uses negative-only weights s_j = softmax(r_j) and per-example loss −log(Σ_j s_j·sigmoid(r_pos−r_j)+10⁻²⁴) + λΣ_j s_j·r_j². Regularization applies to negative scores, weighted by the same softmax; it is separate from parameter weight decay. Official code differentiates through these weights in both terms—no detach/stop-gradient. Scores are after the configured final activation, including optional ELU. [Paper, Eq. 16](https://hidasi.eu/assets/pdf/gru4rec_v2_cikm18.pdf); [official implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidasib/GRU4Rec_PyTorch_Official/master/gru4rec_pytorch.py).

Sampling combines other minibatch targets with a shared pool of additional draws, with replacement, from q(item) ∝ training-frequency(item)^α; α=0 is uniform, α=1 popularity sampling. Current official guidance recommends 2,048 additional samples, potentially fewer for catalogs below 5–10K active items; α is dataset-dependent. Code inspection shows no deduplication or item-ID collision rejection: BPR-max masks only each row’s designated positive column. Duplicate negatives retain multiplicity; positive IDs appearing elsewhere remain negatives. It does not exclude previously consumed items. These training semantics differ from the benchmark’s unique evaluation negatives. [Sampling code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidasib/GRU4Rec_PyTorch_Official/master/gru4rec_pytorch.py); [official guidance](https://github.com/hidasib/GRU4Rec#hyperparameter-tuning).

For a controlled loss-only comparison, replay identical training examples and candidate pools, including multiplicities and collision masks; fix initialization, architecture, score activation, optimizer, updates and evaluation. Compare ordinary mean pairwise −log-sigmoid against BPR-max, documenting reduction/scaling. Adding BPR-max’s score penalty changes regularization too: an additional λ=0 ablation isolates aggregation. Any collision filtering should apply identically to both objectives and be disclosed as a departure from official sampling. This is an experimental recommendation, not a reported Amazon result.
